grammar.pattern: 重新 / 经常 / 老 / 老是 / 又
grammar.purpose: Separate a regular habit from doing something again
grammar.explanation: 经常 describes a regular frequency. 重新 means anew, often replacing an earlier version. 又 reports a further occurrence; use 再 for an intended next action. Colloquial 老/老是 often carry a complaint about repetition, not a person’s age. Say the concrete problem rather than treating a friend’s mistake as a permanent trait.

examples.zh: 我们经常见面，今天重新确认地址。
examples.py: wǒ men jīng cháng jiàn miàn , jīn tiān chóng xīn què rèn dì zhǐ .
examples.en: We meet often; today we are confirming the address anew.

examples.zh: 我又走错了，明天再看新地址。
examples.py: wǒ yòu zǒu cuò le , míng tiān zài kàn xīn dì zhǐ .
examples.en: I went the wrong way again; tomorrow I will check the new address again.

examples.zh: 你老看旧图片，老是走错入口。
examples.py: nǐ lǎo kàn jiù tú piàn , lǎo shì zǒu cuò rù kǒu .
examples.en: You keep looking at the old image and repeatedly take the wrong entrance.

commonMistakes.wrong: 明天我又发一次新地址。
commonMistakes.right: 明天我再发一次新地址。
commonMistakes.why: 再 marks an intended future repetition in this neutral example.

grammar.pattern: arrival → contact → entry; 先 … 再 / 然后 …
grammar.explanation: Actions can follow one another without linking words: 到了，发消息，等朋友. 先…再/然后… makes an ordered plan explicit. 接着 and 接下来 identify the next step. Then does not mean immediately or simultaneously. If entry requires confirmation, do not treat merely arriving outside as entering.

examples.py: dào le , fā xiāo xī , děng péng you .
examples.en: Arrive, message, wait for the friend.

examples.zh: 先看地址，再出门，然后确认入口。
examples.py: xiān kàn dì zhǐ , zài chū mén , rán hòu què rèn rù kǒu .
examples.en: Check the address first, then go out, then confirm the entrance.

examples.zh: 先还书，接着借书，接下来交作业。
examples.py: xiān huán shū , jiē zhe jiè shū , jiē xià lái jiāo zuò yè .
examples.en: Return books, then borrow books, then hand in homework.

grammar.purpose: Connect a trigger to the next action
grammar.explanation: 一到就发消息 means message as soon as arrival occurs. 一…就… links the trigger and response; it does not prove either has happened. Use an actual trigger such as 到北门, not an ambiguous 到了 if there are several entrances. Compare 到了以后再发消息, which does not stress immediacy.

examples.zh: 我一到北门，就给你发消息。
examples.py: wǒ yī dào běi mén , jiù gěi nǐ fā xiāo xī .
examples.en: I will message you as soon as I reach the north gate.

examples.zh: 手机一开机，就能看到新消息。
examples.py: shǒu jī yī kāi jī , jiù néng kàn dào xīn xiāo xī .
examples.en: New messages can be seen as soon as the phone is switched on.

examples.zh: 一确认入口，我们就进去。
examples.py: yī què rèn rù kǒu , wǒ men jiù jìn qù .
examples.en: We will go in as soon as the entrance is confirmed.

commonMistakes.wrong: 一到就发消息，所以现在已经到了。
commonMistakes.right: 一到就发消息，但现在还没到。
commonMistakes.why: The conditional plan does not establish present arrival.

lines.zh: 你出门了吗？我重新发了地址。
lines.py: nǐ chū mén le ma ? wǒ chóng xīn fā le dì zhǐ .
lines.en: Have you gone out? I have sent the address again.
lines.speaker: a

lines.py: wǒ yòu kàn jiù tú piàn le , chà diǎn ér zǒu cuò .

lines.speaker: a

lines.py: diàn huà tōng le ma ?
lines.en: Did the call connect?

lines.speaker: a

prompt.py: suí shí fā xiāo xī , nǐ jiù néng mǎ shàng huí ma ?
prompt.en: If I message at any time, can you reply immediately?

line.py: xiān kàn dì zhǐ , rán hòu chū mén .
line.en: Check the address first, then go out.

line.zh: 进入以后【拿出】要还的书。
line.py: jìn rù yǐ hòu ná chū yào huán de shū .
line.en: Take out the return books after entering.

pairs.left: Go through the entrance, not the exit.

pairs.left: Do not walk away yet; I will ask a staff member.

right.zh: 先别走开，我去问工作人员。
right.py: xiān bié zǒu kāi , wǒ qù wèn gōng zuò rén yuán .

pairs.left: Take your seat before the start; leave after the end.

right.zh: 开场以前先坐好，散场以后再出去。
right.py: kāi chǎng yǐ qián xiān zuò hǎo , sàn chǎng yǐ hòu zài chū qù .
right.en: Take your seat before the start; leave after the end.

pairs.left: It is nearly seven; the programme is about to begin.

right.zh: 快要七点了，节目就要开始了。
right.py: kuài yào qī diǎn le , jié mù jiù yào kāi shǐ le .

pairs.left: We wait ten minutes; it starts at seven.

right.zh: 我们等十分钟，七点开始。
right.py: wǒ men děng shí fēn zhōng , qī diǎn kāi shǐ .
right.en: We wait ten minutes; it starts at seven.

natural.zh: 我重新发了地址，先看最新的消息。
natural.py: wǒ chóng xīn fā le dì zhǐ , xiān kàn zuì xīn de xiāo xī .
natural.en: I sent the address again; check the latest message first.

pragmatics.note: Name the changed detail rather than blaming the reader.

natural.zh: 我一到东边，就给你发消息。
natural.py: wǒ yī dào dōng biān , jiù gěi nǐ fā xiāo xī .
natural.en: I will message as soon as I reach the east side.
